remarks: *Unique investment opportunity* at 152 Bird Ave featuring two separate homes on one property, conveniently located near Buffalo State University with easy access to Elmwood Village, Delaware Park, and many of Buffalo's popular destinations. This is a rare three-unit investment opportunity featuring a two-family home plus a detached single-family home on one lot that has remained in the same family for the past 73 years. The front home offers two units and showcases beautiful original character throughout, including preserved woodwork, two stunning fireplaces and newer roof (2022) full tear off. The rear property is a single-family home offering approximately 1,185 additional sq.ft. with tremendous potential for an investor or buyer ready to bring their vision to life. While extensive renovation is needed, improvements have already been started, including fresh drywall, recessed lighting, drain tile installed at the rear and side of the home, and foundation work in the rear kitchen area, where the structure has been lifted and additional support added. With three potential living units between the two homes, this property presents an exciting opportunity for investment, renovation, or future income potential. Bring your ideas and unlock the possibilities this unique property has to offer! Minimum of 24 hours notice is needed for private showings, 36-48 hour notice is preferred.
